result.stdout:
Xemele XML/HTML toolkit
Usage: xemele <command> [options]
  --help  Show help
  canonicalize  Canonicalize XML
  catalog  Resolve a catalog identifier
  format  Format XML
  html-fragment  Parse an HTML5 fragment in a real context
  html-legacy  Parse with legacy HTML recovery
  html-select  Select HTML elements using CSS
  html5  Parse with the HTML5 algorithm
  lint  Lint XML/HTML files, directories, or stdin
  parse  Parse XML and emit compact XML
  validate-dtd  Validate XML against a DTD
  validate-rng  Validate XML against a RELAX NG XML schema
  validate-schematron  Validate XML using ISO 2016 Schematron
  validate-xsd  Validate XML against an XML Schema 1.0 schema
  xinclude  Expand XInclude
  xpath  Evaluate XPath 1.0
